question: What lost-link incidents have been reported for the DJI Matrice 4T?

intake.reason: User asks for reported lost-link incidents for the DJI Matrice 4T. Our collection includes NASA ASRS incident reports and manufacturer manuals; we can summarize available guidance and note whether any Matrice 4T-specific incidents are present in NASA ASRS within the collection.

brief.short_answer: There is no usable evidence found in the approved collection for FAA guidance. The DJI Matrice 4T manual states that on signal loss the aircraft will automatically initiate RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH; DJI Pilot 2 can display the RTH path when conditions permit; it will use Advanced RTH per RTH settings; it will remain in RTH even if the signal is restored; and if the RTH distance exceeds 50 m, it will back up 50 m on its original route before Preset RTH. There are no reported lost-link incidents (unverified accounts) in the provided material.
